verdict.rationale: Harbor Compliance's registered-agent service delivers service of process and legal documents electronically (docs-19). The OpenAPI probe mentions registered-agent-deliveries read endpoints, which suggests received items can be retrieved after the fact. However, the same probe also reports registered-agent endpoints as absent, and nothing documents retention or an in-account archive of received notices. Records Manager and annual-report document visibility cover different document types. missing for 10: an explicit documented archive of received registered-agent documents, a stated retention period or proof of retrieval months later, consistent API evidence for the deliveries endpoints, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
